text:
marina: ACME disputed INV-2024-0042 — large Dedicated overage in us-west2 from their DR test over the weekend (2024-04-02 -> 2024-04-03). Overage line shows $12,120. They claim traffic should have used reserved failover pool but was billed on-demand. Dropping here to triage and decide credit.
invoicer-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0042 generated for ACME Corp — total $28,432 (overage $12,120). Payment due in 30 days.
devin-bill: CS says customer ran a scheduled failover and expects reserved capacity to absorb traffic. They're asking for a waiver. @sree can you check routing/labels?
sree: quick audit: several allocations in us-west2 during the window lacked the nodepool label used to match reserved capacity. Metering attributes at allocation time. example log: `2024-04-02T03:12:01Z ALLOCATE pod=acme-dr labels={region:us-west2,nodepool:unlabeled} -> ROUTE pool=on-demand`
sree: root cause looks like a tagging regression in the failover pipeline. eng can add a CI admission check + runtime guard and alert on unlabeled allocations. retro attribution is manual — billing ops would need a credit memo and allocation IDs.
carmen-cs: ACME is a multi-year committed customer. they'll accept a compromise (not full waiver) if we pair a credit with a written fix plan and timeline plus a short SLA commitment for failovers.
oliver-legal: per T&Cs credits are for platform SLA breaches. avoid admitting liability. legal okay with goodwill credit if we include a release clause: credit = full settlement, no admission of fault. marina, collect invoice + allocation IDs for memo.
marina: finance proposal: one-time goodwill credit = 50% of the overage ($6,060) + waive burst charges for 2 months up to $3k/month. keeps precedent limited. approve?
devin-bill: ACME told CS they'd accept that if we provide the settlement letter and commit to the tagging guardrail.
sree: engineering can implement the tagging enforcement and pre-deploy gate within 48 hours. opening INFRA-4821 to track. we can also produce a usage attribution report for the disputed window to support manual adjustment.
oliver-legal: fine. legal will draft settlement language with release. CS to collect signature; finance to issue credit memo once signed.
ben: approve 50% goodwill credit + 2mo burst waiver cap. finance, coordinate with legal + CS. eng deliver the fix and confirm.
carmen-cs: I'll send the settlement template to ACME now and request sign-off. will post the signed doc here when returned.
marina: thanks all. finance will prepare provisional credit memo and queue manual adjustment pending signed settlement. leaving thread open until CS confirms signature and billing posts credit.
